1. Snap the two corners of the drag to whole pixels. They bound the ellipse.
2. With Shift, make a circle. With Alt, use the start point as the center.
3. Give each pixel the part of it that lies inside the ellipse, from 4 rows of samples per pixel.
4. Feather the shape when the feather setting is above 0.
5. Combine it with the current selection by the mode.
